ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis represents latitude, from 10°N, 5°S to 30°S, 37°S, 50°S; the vertical axis represents altitude. The legend shows different natural belts, among which “C” corresponds to a kind of mountain-foot natural belt. Observing the low-altitude part at the mountain foot, natural belt C roughly extends from near 5°S all the way to near 30°S, and the latitude it spans is wider than that of other mountain-foot natural belts. Then reason: this range is located on the western slope of the Andes in South America, from low latitudes to the subtropical west coast, and the coast is obviously affected by the Peru Current. A cold current has the effect of cooling and reducing moisture and suppressing precipitation, causing the coastal arid desert landscape to extend north-south along the coast; therefore, the main factor causing natural belt C to have the widest latitudinal span is ocean current.

method.method_draft: 先读图：横轴为纬度，从10°N到50°S；纵轴为高度；图例中“丙”对应的山麓自然带在安第斯山西坡低海拔处从约5°S一直延伸到30°S附近，所跨纬度明显最广。再读题：问题限定为“山麓自然带”并问丙带纬度跨度大的主要因素。将图中丙带所在位置对应到南美洲安第斯山西坡低纬—副热带西海岸，可判断其属于受沿岸秘鲁寒流影响形成并延伸的干旱荒漠带。依据寒流降温减湿、抑制降水并使沿岸荒漠带沿海岸南北延伸的规律，得出主要因素是洋流。
